newsitem.title: USA: Irvine Apartment names chairman to CEO post.
newsitem.headline: Irvine Apartment names chairman to CEO post.

text.p: Irvine Apartment Communities said Wednesday its chariman, Donald Bren, would assume the post of chief executive, succeeding Steven Albert, current president and CEO.
Irvine is the dominant owner and operator of apartment properties on Southern California's 90-square-mile Irvine Ranch.
Albert is leaving the company, Irvine said.
"This signals a move by the company to focus on off-ranch activities, to expand into other activities in California," said Tyler Rose, senior vice president and treasurer, in a telephone interview.
The company said it reorganized and strengthened its senior management structure to reflect its expanding focus of operations.
